Jamal: Heads-up — router v2 roll tonight 22:00 UTC. This changes header routing and sticky session handling. We need API and runtime pinned for the window. Please confirm compatibility and fallback plan. Release notes: https://go/internal/release/router-v2

DeployBot: SCHEDULED 1767200000 Release router-v2 window 22:00-23:00 UTC. Services: router v2.0.0, api 1.4.2 (pin), runtime 3.1.0 (compat). Canary plan attached.

DeployBot: ```
services:
  router: v2.0.0
  api: 1.4.2 (pinned)
  runtime: 3.1.0 (compat-shim)
canary: 5->25->100
fallback: router:v1
metrics: p95 latency, 5xx rate, runtime cpu%
```

Kyra: Runtime question — 3.1.0 includes a KV cache layout tweak. There's a compatibility shim but it only activates when the 'x-router-format' header is present. Are we shipping that header from API during the canary? If not, we should hold until shim is verified.

Alex: API 1.4.2 will set `x-router-format: v2` when feature-flag `ff.api.router_v2` is enabled. We'll flip the flag at canary start. Also confirming we'll pin API to 1.4.2 for the change window.

Marta: Console note — UI changes for router v2 are behind `ff.console.router_v2`. We'll not enable UI by default; enabling 10% during canary. Also please add a short ops note about header visibility in the routing table view.

Jamal: Proposed canary: 5% (15m) -> 25% (15m) -> 100%. Abort conditions: p95 latency increase > 20% OR error rate (5xx) > +1% absolute OR runtime CPU/GPU saturation > 75% for 10m. If any trigger fires we fallback to router:v1. Agree?

SRE-Jen: I'll pre-warm runtime pools and bump desired replicas by 20% 30m before window. Will also pin autoscaler min to avoid churn during canary. I’ll keep an eye on pod restarts and OOMs.

Runtime-Oncall: On it — validating KV shim in staging now. Will paste logs in ~15m.

DeployBot: CANARY STARTED (id: dpl-2034) — 5% traffic routed to router v2. Metrics dashboard: https://go/internal/dash/dpl-2034

DeployBot: CANARY PROGRESS: bumped to 25% at 22:20 UTC — no anomaly fire. Monitoring runtime cold starts and p95.

Alex: Quick observability check — sampling 100 traces: header propagated successfully in all traces we checked. :thumbsup:

Marta: Enabling console `ff.console.router_v2` to 10% now. Ops note updated in release doc.

Jamal: If no alerts by 22:35 I'd like to move to 100% in 15m. Rollback playbook (saved):

Jamal: Rollback commands:
kubectl -n platform set image deploy/router router=image:redwood/router:v1.9.8
# API unpin - revert config key
/redwoodctl config set api.router.default v1

DeployBot: ROLLOUT COMPLETE: 100% at 22:55 UTC. No rollback triggered. Closing thread. :tada:
